title: AutoMA3 look file
description: Looks (grandMA3 executors) and how AutoMA3 uses them. Format 'automa3-looks', version 1. See docs/looks-format.md. Import is lenient: AutoMA3 ignores unknown fields, and every look field except a location for new looks is optional.

version.description: Format version. Files with a newer version are imported with a note; unknown fields are ignored.

exportedBy.description: Program that wrote the file, e.g. 'AutoMA3 1.0.7'. Informational.

mode.description: Case-insensitive on import. TOGGLE = Go+ / Off, FLASH = Flash On / Flash Off, TEMP = Temp On / Temp Off, FADER = FaderMaster level only.

section.description: Case-insensitive on import; unknown values are dropped with a note.

id.description: Stable id. On import it matches an existing look; new looks keep it unless it is already taken.

layer.description: Scene roles keep one running look per layer. Empty or equal to the role name = the role's default layer.

ma3.description: Location in grandMA3. page/exec/sequence may also be given at the top level of the look.

exec.description: Executor number on the page (e.g. 101, 201). Required for a new look.

sequence.description: Sequence on that executor; enables operator-touch detection (MA3 2.1+).

sections.description: Sections the look may be used in. Empty = any.

flashBeats.description: Flash looks: beats to stay on, 0 = AutoMA3's default for the role.

disableOnly.description: Import only: switch off a matching look, never add one (merge); skipped otherwise.

meta.description: Free data for other tools; AutoMA3 keeps it untouched and exports it again.

context.description: How the show connects to AutoMA3. Only applied on import when asked for.

speedMaster.description: Speed master AutoMA3 sets to the DJ's BPM (Master 3.N).

controlPrefix.description: OSC address prefix of the operator controls, e.g. '/automa3'.

oscInPort.description: UDP port AutoMA3 listens on for console feedback and controls.

controlSequences.description: Sequence number (as string) -> control action, using MA3 playback feedback (2.1+).
